components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action on a screen: charcoal sign plate, navy on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>새 프로젝트</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:40px;padding:0 16px;border:1.5px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;background:#25282d;color:#fff;font:700 13px/1.2 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, -apple-system, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', system-ui, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:#0052a4}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #0052a4;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Companion action: white plate with a strong rule border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:40px;padding:0 16px;border:1.5px solid #aeb4bd;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;color:#1c1f24;font:700 13px/1.2 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, -apple-system, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', system-ui, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)}.ds-btn-secondary:hover{border-color:#1c1f24}.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #0052a4;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Form input with label; navy focus, danger on error.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:6px;font:700 13px/1.4 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, -apple-system, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', system-ui, sans-serif;color:#474c55}.ds-input{min-height:42px;padding:8px 12px;border:1.5px solid #aeb4bd;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;color:#1c1f24;font:400 15px/1.5 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, -apple-system, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', system-ui, sans-serif}.ds-input::placeholder{color:#666c76}.ds-input:focus-visible{border-color:#0052a4;outline:3px solid rgba(0,82,164,.28);outline-offset:0}

components.name: Station Navigation
components.description: Pages as stations on a rail; the current one is the white station-name plate.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;padding:12px 20px;background:#25282d;font:600 13px/1.2 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, -apple-system, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', system-ui, sans-serif}.ds-nav a{color:#c3c8d0;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a:hover{color:#fff}.ds-nav .ds-now{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:4px 12px 5px;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;color:#1c1f24}.ds-now b{font-weight:800;font-size:15px}.ds-now small{font:600 11px 'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#666c76}

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Station/status filter; the current filter is a charcoal pill.
components.css: .ds-chips{display:flex;gap:6px}.ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:34px;padding:0 12px;border:1.5px solid #dcdfe4;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;color:#474c55;font:600 13px 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, -apple-system, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', system-ui, sans-serif;text-decoration:none}.ds-chip i{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #0052a4;box-sizing:border-box}.ds-chip:hover{border-color:#666c76;color:#1c1f24}.ds-chip[aria-current=true]{background:#25282d;border-color:#25282d;color:#fff}

components.name: Line Badge
components.description: Automation platform as a metro line: coloured disc with its letter, plus the name.
components.css: .ds-line{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font:600 13px 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, -apple-system, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', system-ui, sans-serif;color:#1c1f24}.ds-line i{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;color:#fff;font:700 13px/1 'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif;font-style:normal}

components.name: Station Stop
components.description: A station on a line: white disc with an 8px line-coloured ring, label plate below; selected gets the yellow halo.
components.css: .ds-stops{position:relative;display:flex;gap:60px;padding:8px 20px}.ds-rail{position:absolute;left:60px;right:60px;top:25px;height:8px;background:#8e5fb5}.ds-stop{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;border:0;background:none;font:700 13px 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, -apple-system, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', system-ui, sans-serif;color:#1c1f24;cursor:pointer}.ds-stop i{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:8px solid #8e5fb5;background:#fff;box-sizing:border-box}.ds-stop b{font:700 11px 'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#666c76}.ds-sel i{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #fff,0 0 0 7px #ffcd00,0 0 0 9px #25282d}.ds-stop:focus-visible i{outline:3px solid #0052a4;outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Timetable Row
components.description: Ruled list of records with tabular amounts; the default container for data.
components.css: .ds-tt{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font:400 15px 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, -apple-system, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', system-ui, sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-tt th{padding:10px 12px;background:#f3f4f6;border-bottom:2px solid #25282d;color:#474c55;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-align:left}.ds-tt td{padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #dcdfe4}.ds-tt td:last-child,.ds-tt th:last-child{text-align:right}.ds-tt tbody tr:hover{background:#fafbfc}

narrative.overview: AutoMate Pro draws a one-person automation agency as a Seoul-style metro network. Client work travels a navy delivery line station by station (대기 → 분석 → 개발 → 테스트 → 배포) and interchanges onto a green circle line, the maintenance subscriptions that keep running every month; the monthly recurring revenue sits inside that loop. It is an Operate tool first: white map ground, dense ruled timetables instead of cards, one workhorse Korean sans, colour only where it encodes something. The printable quote deliberately steps out of the map into plain black-and-white Korean business paperwork.
keyCharacteristics: White map ground; charcoal sign band with white Hangul and one yellow marker for "here".
Line colours are data: navy = delivery, green = maintenance loop, one colour per platform.
Stations are white discs with a line-coloured ring; conditions/interchanges are white capsules with a charcoal ring; triggers are filled termini.
Ruled timetables (2px charcoal head rule, 1px row rules, tabular numerals) instead of card grids.
Pretendard for everything readable; Barlow Semi Condensed only for station codes, D-day tags and English sub-labels.

rules.name: The Line Means Something Rule
rules.body: A line colour appears only where it encodes a line: delivery, maintenance or a platform. No decorative colour fields.

rules.name: The One Yellow Rule
rules.body: Exit yellow marks the single current/selected thing in view (plus focus on dark and text selection). Two yellow markers on one screen is a bug.

rules.name: The Signage Numerals Rule
rules.body: The condensed face is for codes painted on the map, never for body copy, amounts or headings.

rules.name: The Flat Map Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the map floats. Selection is shown with a yellow-and-charcoal halo ring or by turning a label into a charcoal plate, never with elevation.

dos: **Do** encode meaning with line colour and keep every colour paired with a letter, word or icon.
**Do** draw connectors octilinear (horizontal, vertical, 45°) at one line weight with rounded bends.
**Do** use ruled timetables with tabular numerals for lists of records.
**Do** keep motion to state changes: 160–280ms, `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, instant under reduced motion.
**Do** label demo content as 샘플 데이터 wherever it could read as real.
donts: **Don't** bring back the legacy gradient/glass/stat-card look.
**Don't** use exit yellow for anything but the single current/selected marker, focus on dark and selection.
**Don't** set amounts, body or headings in the condensed signage face.
**Don't** build card grids of icon + heading + text; lists of records are timetables.
**Don't** open modals for confirmations; confirm inline next to the action.
